parts.text: In this experiment, you will determine the focal length of a converging lens by two different methods. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 3.1.

parts.text: (a) Arrange the apparatus as shown in Fig. 3.1. Set the distance u between the illuminated triangle and the lens to 30.0 cm. Place the screen near the lens. Move the screen until a sharp image of the triangle is seen on the screen.
